current_answer: BridgeAI Deployment Catalyst Phase 1 is open to a UK AI SME with a TRL 5–6 working product and an eligible UK deployer. The consortium may request £100,000–£200,000 in partial feasibility-grant funding by 8 December 2026, 11:00 UK time. The £5 million headline is the competition pot, not a per-startup award. Later stages are not guaranteed.

catalogue_card.question: Can your AI startup apply for the new £5 million BridgeAI call?
catalogue_card.text: Only with a UK deployer and a TRL 5–6 working product. The consortium may request £100,000–£200,000 by 8 December at 11:00 UK time; the £5 million is the total competition pot. Funding covers only part of eligible costs.

summary: A UK AI SME must lead with an eligible UK medium/large or public-sector deployer; outside investment is not a published gate.
The phase-one consortium request is £100,000–£200,000; commercial cost funding is partial and later phases are not guaranteed.
NLnet CodeSupply remains open through 3 November under policy v2.0.
uncertainty: Applicant-specific consortium, cost and scope eligibility require issuer review; no award was verified.
First-party analytics and applicant outcomes are unavailable.
